name: Nimshi
title: Jehu's grandfather and founder of a royal dynasty
summary: Nimshi is best known as the grandfather of Jehu, who was anointed king over Israel. Although little is written directly about Nimshi himself, his name is closely linked to Jehu's dynasty, and Jehu is often referred to as 'son of Nimshi' in the Bible. Nimshi was the father of Jehoshaphat, who in turn was the father of Jehu, the king who destroyed the house of Ahab.

keyEvents.title: God's command to anoint Jehu
keyEvents.description: God commanded the prophet Elijah to anoint Jehu, Nimshi's grandson, as king over Israel as an instrument of judgment against the house of Ahab.

keyEvents.title: Jehu referred to as son of Nimshi
keyEvents.description: Jehu is repeatedly identified as 'son of Nimshi' in the biblical accounts, highlighting Nimshi's significance as the founder of the dynasty.

keyEvents.title: Elisha Sends a Prophet's Apprentice to Anoint Jehu
keyEvents.description: The prophet Elisha sent one of the prophets' apprentices to anoint Jehu, son of Jehoshaphat and grandson of Nimshi, as king over Israel.

keyEvents.title: Jehu's Revolt Against Joram
keyEvents.description: Jehu, a descendant of Nimshi, led the revolt against King Joram of Israel, killed him, and thus fulfilled the prophecy concerning judgment on Ahab's house.

keyEvents.title: The Dynasty of Nimshi on Israel's Throne
keyEvents.description: Jehu's dynasty, which descended from Nimshi, ruled over Israel for four generations, just as God had promised Jehu because he carried out judgment against Ahab's house.

keyEvents.title: Reference in the Books of Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Jehu, son of Nimshi, is also mentioned in the Books of Chronicles in connection with his confrontation with King Jehoshaphat of Judah and his actions against Ahab's house.
